reviews.text: After trying a few other salons I wasn't expecting anything spectacular, but I was pleasantly surprised at how great my experience was with Salon DuBois.
reviews.author: Sarah B.

reviews.text: It's always a little challenging for me to find a salon where I know I am going to receive professional service for a decent price. Thankfully, Alan took the time to understand exactly what I was looking for and gave me just what I wanted on my first visit.
reviews.author: Derek

reviews.text: The knowledgeable and friendly staff at Salon DuBois are top flight professionals. Alan is a lifelong student of his craft who is always learning and clearly understands modern trends.
reviews.author: Derek
